international.title: ‘Deeply concerning’: NHS in England reports more than 3,000 incidents of staff snooping on patients’ records
international.summary: Campaign groups and regulators say data breaches are distressing for patients and families and erode trust in the health service The NHS in England has recorded more than 3,000 incidents of staff inappropriately snooping on patients’ medical records in the last five years. Patient campaign groups and regulators said the figures were “deeply concerning” and distressing for patients and families, and eroded trust in the health service. A lack of transparency from NHS organisations after data breaches were uncovered further compounded the heartache, they added. Continue reading...
